in_marathi.name: Kantha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kantha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kantha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kantha' which means 'throat'. It is also associated with the goddess Kali, who is known as the 'Goddess of Strength' and the 'Goddess of Love'. The name symbolizes the power and strength of the throat, as well as the ability to express love and emotions.
